title: Uruguayan Flaxseed Skillet
description: A hearty and nutritious dish inspired by the flavors of Uruguay, made with flaxseed and cooked to perfection in a skillet.
instructions: Heat the skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the olive oil and swirl to coat.
Add the charred scallions and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional minute.
In a separate bowl, mix together the flaxseed and a pinch of salt.
Add the flaxseed mixture to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the flaxseed is lightly toasted.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, topped with grated cheddar cheese if desired.
